Angular Material (AngularJS) documentation website, 2016

The 2016 home page of Google’s Material library for AngularJS, with a blue side navigation and flat gray tiles.

Rights
Third-party work, stored with credit for commentary. License: unverified. Rights policy

The live site now documents the end of long-term support for AngularJS Material, which ended in January 2022.

Observed

  • A blue navigation drawer on the left holds a red Angular shield, the name “Angular Material” in white, and sections in white all-capital labels with small chevrons.
  • A pale gray header bar reads “Introduction” and casts a thin shadow over the white content area.
  • The content is Roboto on white, with four flat light gray tiles (GETTING STARTED, DEMOS, CUSTOMIZATION, API REFERENCE), each with a gray Material icon and an all-capital label.
  • Links in the tiles are a red-pink accent color.

Why it belongs

The page measures shadows on only 8 % of its boxes, with a median blur of 7.5 px and offset of 2 px. Most of its boxes are flat gray tiles and navigation rows, so the shadow share falls far below the specimen.

Borrow

Put navigation on the primary color and content on white, and use gray tiles with a single icon and an all-capital label for primary links.
